verdict.rationale: CrewAI's docs include an API reference section for the deployed-crew REST API (POST /kickoff, GET /status/{kickoff_id}, POST /resume), reachable via llms.txt, and they show static code examples. Nothing shows the reference is interactive or that its examples can be run, and probes found no OpenAPI/Swagger spec at the usual paths. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, runnable examples, a published OpenAPI spec, coverage beyond the three AMP endpoints, and independent corroboration.
